summary: Second canvas-family umbrella, opened after the user spotted MPI-424 in done with family work still outstanding. Verified first: 424 is correctly closed - all five of its members shipped. The five open cards (426, 435, 436, 439, 421) were never members of it, so the fix is a new umbrella, not a reopen. Order and the one shared alpha-vs-luminance decision are in brief.md.

Umbrella #2 picked up. Order CORRECTED after reading all four member cards end to end: MPI-421 is not independent (it shares MpiCanvasViewer exec.onMasks with MPI-426, so they are a pair), and MPI-435 drops from second to last (pure polish, brushDab.js already shipped, blocks nothing). New order 426 -> 421 -> 436 -> 439 -> 435.

Member 1 of 5 shipped: MPI-426 done and user-validated (f64fc75e). Session ends here by choice, umbrella stays in doing. NEXT IS MPI-421 - it shares MpiCanvasViewer exec.onMasks with the card just closed, which is why the order was corrected to put it second. Standing decision now inherited by every remaining member: hasMask() means BAKED content only, and the op strip gates on it, so a bare detection leaves masked ops locked until Add. Still open and still needing ONE shared answer before 436/439 diverge: does an op read paint alpha or luminance, and do soft edges survive.

MPI-421 built (commit 1028b958), in-app pass outstanding. MPI-441 added as a member and sequenced before MPI-436: the user's Grow screenshots show MaskManager._morph rounds a mask off instead of growing it, and 436 reuses that same primitive.

Member MPI-435 (alpha brush pack) is BUILT and validating - commit fb0cf4c4. Taken out of this cards order at the users request, while a peer session closes MPI-439 and MPI-445. Not editing brief.md to mark it, because that peer is writing the same file; the member table needs a MPI-435 row when they are done. One decision recorded for the set: the shape of a soft dab fades to the dab OWN colour at alpha 0, never the CSS keyword transparent - Chromium interpolates canvas gradient stops NON-premultiplied and transparent drags a soft rim through black. Any future canvas gradient in this family inherits that.

Closed under MPI-450 Gate D. Every member shipped and was user-validated in the app: MPI-426, MPI-441, MPI-436, MPI-421, MPI-445, MPI-439 and MPI-435 (the last, commit e6229bd3). The card had no validation.md of its own because each member carries one; validation.md now records that and links them.
Archived out of board.columns.done to .agents/mpi-kanban/tasks/_archived/MPI-440/ (workspace preserved intact). mpi-archive run 2026-08-21.
